children: British health and safety device maker Halma
on Thursday raised its forecast for its annual adjusted operating profit margin after a strong first half and the positive impact of recent acquisitions and disposals.
The company said it now expects adjusted operating profit margin between 23.5% and 24.0% for the year ending March 2027, up from previous guidance of around 22.7%.
